bar.text: Combined seas building to 8 to 11 ft through Friday morning, subsiding to 6 ft later today. Bar conditions rough, becoming moderate later today. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 330 PM this afternoon, 345 AM Saturday morning, and 400 PM Saturday. The Saturday afternoon ebb will be strong.
